messages:
alice: Quick check — need confirmation on keystore / HSM rotation policy for TLS keys across environments. Two specific asks:
1) Who owns the private key rotation schedule for Dedicated vs Hosted? monthly/quarterly/yearly?
2) Any outstanding logging that might accidentally capture key material (PEM blocks, key IDs) at debug level?
We need to update the runbook and make sure access approvals are set (who can request emergency rotation).

ben: TL;DR:
- Public TLS leaf certs: auto-renew (ACME) for hosted endpoints (90d).
- Internal TLS leaf certs + service-to-service mTLS: rotated quarterly by infra.
- HSM-backed root/private keys (customer Keystore/HSM): rotation cadence is annual by default; KMS customer-managed keys have automatic monthly rotation where enabled.
- Owners: infra (for infra-owned certs), security for policy sign-off, customer success for customer-kept keys (we do not rotate customer private keys unless contract says so).

carmen: Quick note on logs: found one debug path that logs full certs in raw PEM for the TLS debug hook (dev only) — filing PR to redact. We should ensure redaction regex is in centralized logging agent config. Example redaction we want in the agent: 

```
# redact private key PEM bodies
regex: '(-----BEGIN (?:RSA )?PRIVATE KEY-----)([\s\S]*?)(-----END (?:RSA )?PRIVATE KEY-----)'
replace: '\1[REDACTED]\3'
```

Also we should blacklist printing of `key_material` fields in service logs (some libs dump key metadata at TRACE).

infra-bot: Rotation job scheduled: https://ci.internal/jobs/rotate-keystore-2026-04-05 ✓
Job owner: @ben. Next run: 2026-04-05 03:00 UTC.

ben: Approvals: emergency rotation requires a ticket in the change board + two approvers from `security-approvers` group. Normal scheduled rotations follow the infra runbook (no extra approvals). If someone needs temporary HSM access, we use the short-lived bastion flow (SSO -> request -> 1hr token). Example verify command (HSM vendor CLI):

```
# show key metadata
hsmctl show-key --key-id=projects/keystore/keys/tls-root --format json
```

dave: Can we add `rotations@redwood.com` to the notification list for those jobs and also grant temporary rotate privileges to ops-oncall for the first 6 months of the dedicated rollout? Cassie will need emergency access for the first week of traffic cutover.

alice: Yes to notifications — please add `rotations@redwood.com`.
I also want the runbook updated to explicitly call out:
- redaction checks in logging agent (carmen please add test)
- who signs emergency rotation (security lead + infra eng)
- audit trail steps (KMS/HSM key version change logging, runbook checklist)

carmen: I'll open the PR against `infra/runbooks/keystore-rotation.md` and add the logging-agent redaction test and a unit test for the debug-path that was emitting PEMs. Will request review from @ben and @alice.

ben: Added `rotations@redwood.com` to job notifications and updated the CI job to annotate run with audit-id. Also pushed a short note to the oncall handbook about temporary HSM access flow.

carmen: PR created: https://git.internal/infra/runbooks/pull/248 — includes the regex and tests. Tagging reviewers.

alice: Perfect — once PR merges, update the security checklist and I'll close the ticket. Thanks all :thumbsup:

carmen: Will do, filing the access request for Cassie now. Closing loop after merge.
